title: Named Ops complaint investigator can read detail but cannot list their own assignments
actual: Quality can assign a fresh synthetic Acknowledged complaint to demo.ops (investigator_user_id27). As that named investigator GET /complaints/2 returns200 and can_write_findings/can_update/can_add_action true, but GET /complaints?mine=true&status=Acknowledged&limit=1000 returns403 FORBIDDEN (requires complaint.view/manage/register). The screen cannot discover its own assignments or offer its conditional menu without bypassing the declared list permissions.
expected: Complaints workflow §3 says investigators are any member of staff named, whatever their role, and rule0e24fdd6ab requires their mine=true Acknowledged list. Supply an authorised own-assignment list for such staff, with matching x-permissions/access metadata, while preserving privacy of other complaints. No local role changes or guessed IDs should be required.
steps: Current DEV. As demo.reception create a SuggestionBox/Anonymous explicitly synthetic complaint. As demo.quality acknowledge it with contact/investigator selected from GET /staff/lookup?q=Ops (returned user27). As demo.ops read GET /complaints?mine=true&status=Acknowledged&limit=1000, then GET /complaints/2. Fresh fixture2, not a historical example.
